name: Sushi Go!

categories.label: Maki rolls
categories.help: Points for having the most or second-most maki icons this round.

categories.label: Tempura pairs
categories.help: Pairs of tempura this round (5 points each).

categories.label: Sashimi sets
categories.help: Complete sets of three sashimi this round (10 points each).

categories.label: Dumplings
categories.help: Points from your dumpling count this round, using the rising scale.

categories.label: Nigiri
categories.help: Points from nigiri this round, including wasabi-tripled ones.

categories.label: Pudding
categories.help: Points after round three: most puddings gains, fewest loses.

categories.label: Pudding cards
categories.help: Pudding cards you collected across all rounds; the most wins a tie.

notes: Three rounds; pudding is the only end-of-game category. Category list recalled from the publisher rulebook and not yet re-checked against the printed copy (see source.checked_against_rulebook).
